universe.name: عالم توتي
universe.story_format: independent social stories; continuity is optional

main_character.name: تالا

appearance.features: very cute, soft, childlike facial features

personality: sometimes afraid, jealous, angry, sad, or unsure
learns from experiences instead of always knowing the answer
main_character.speech: natural, simple Arabic suitable for a 10-year-old

family.name: ريم
traits: works outside and inside the home
wants her children to succeed academically
can unintentionally put pressure on them

family.name: عبدالله
traits: likes playing with his children when home

story_rules.family_principle: Parents love their children but can make mistakes; children are not responsible for solving adult problems.
sensitive_topic_rules: Do not show sexual or graphic details involving children.
Never blame a child for abuse, harassment, bullying, or danger.
For danger, prioritize getting away when possible and telling a trusted adult.
Do not make a child responsible for fixing adult relationships.
Do not invent medical, legal, or psychological claims.

visual_consistency.instruction: Preserve the same identity, facial features, hair color, eye color, age, and childlike proportions for recurring characters across scenes and videos.
